m_dialogEntries.m_dialog: I am glad you are the ones who volunteered for this operation. I can think of no one better suited for the job.
Look there, across the city. You see that ugly flag? That's the flag of Walruskberg flying high, the Empress's crown looming over us all.
You must fight your way into that tower and use the Flag Control Pulley to raise the proud flag of Penguinonia in its place.
That's the signal to Patriôtes across the city to attack. We will subdue the Enforcers and the city will be ours!
Don't worry, little Red. Ivan and Wizard will be victorious! Your new flag will fly proudly over city soon.
Halt! By order of her Majesty, Empress Antuskette the First... hold on, it's that Osky who escaped from the Basstille! To arms, men!
Haha! And some say Ivan the Great is getting old! Fighting with you, Ivan feels like young cub again!\n
Let us go up and change flags and then find next battle, comrade!
I would ask how you fared, but it's plain to see!
For the first time in many seasons, the flag of Penguinonia flies over the city once again! It is a proud moment!
For too many seasons have we Pingouins endured the tyranny of this gross Empress and her militant Osky enforcers!
They have taken our city, they have taken our freedom, they have taken our fish, and they have even taken our friends...
Yes, yes. Liberté ... Vive La Penguinonia ... we know already! We have a revolution to fight here, Danton. Can't we skip the speech?
But of course, mademoiselle. The hour of reckoning has arrived. We must rise up and... all right, sorry. I'll get to the point.
Patriôtes across the city are awaiting our signal. We change the flag in the flag tower and they will attack soon after.
Our new friend here, Ivan the Great, has graciously volunteered himself and the Wizard for this critical task.
Ivan hopes you do not mind, comrade, but together, we are mighty force! We crush our enemies before us! Haha!
Yes, well, that sounds just... wonderful. You two meet me back up in the city and I will show you what to do.
Be brave, mes amis, and be bold, for the bold will win the day, and victory will be assured! Vive la Penguinonia!
